info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Promotional Events Retrieval API
info.description: The Promotional Events Retrieval API enables businesses to access detailed information about promotional events related to banking marketing initiatives. By utilizing this endpoint, users can retrieve data associated with specific promotional events, enhancing engagement and user experience. This API is particularly beneficial for marketing teams and data analysts who need to analyze the effectiveness of promotional campaigns. Typical use cases include generating reports, evaluating event performance, and tailoring marketing strategies based on consumer interaction data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific promotional event using its unique identifier. It is designed for marketing analysis and event management purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding promotional events associated with the specific identifier RES-100045. It contains parameters that specify the details about the request being made.

200.description: The request was successful and promotional event details were retrieved successfully.

GetMarketingPromotionalEventByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to promotional events in the marketing system.

GetMarketingPromotionalEventByIdResponse.title: Promotional Event Response

campaignId.description: The unique identifier for the marketing campaign.

targetSegmentId.description: The identifier for the target segment of the campaign.

channelMix.description: A list of channels used in the campaign.

items.description: A channel used for the promotional event.

budget.description: The budget details for the marketing campaign.

startDate.description: The start date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: The end date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the campaign record.

version.description: The version number for the campaign record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp for when the campaign was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetMarketingPromotionalEventByIdResponse.description: Schema representing the response of a promotional event operation, detailing various properties related to marketing campaigns.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication mechanism, where a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) is required for API access. The token must be included in the Authorization header of the request, formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.
